SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-08-2022 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF TO JUL-20-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE PRO TEM: WILLIAM LYNN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUE PER PLAINTIFF REQUEST.
DECLARATION RE: UPDATE CONTACT INFO FILED BY DEFENDANT AGUILAR, JOSELITO
ORDER OF CONTINUANCE PURSUANT TO PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-20-2022 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF TO AUG-19-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF CINDY MALUNAO IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT JOSELITO AGUILAR IS PRESENT AND IS NOTIFIED OF THE CONTINUANCE. (SEE NOTES) JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF CINDY MALUNAO IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT JOSELITO AGUILAR IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $351.05 TO THE PLAINTIFF. DEFENDANT MADE A PAYMENT OF $351.05 VIA ZELLE IN THE COURT HALLWAY. THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: A. DATT / D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-02-2022 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT TO JUN-08-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF CINDY MALUNAO IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS CINTHIA MALUNAO. DEFENDANT JOSELITO AGUILAR IS PRESENT. THE COURT FINDS THAT THE STATUTE OF LIMITATION ALLOWS FOR 4 YEARS FROM THE FILING. THE TIME PERIOD IN WHICH THE PLAINTIFF CAN FOCUS ON FOR MORGAGE PAYMENTS, INSURANCE PAYMENTS, AND REPAIRS IS JAN-26-2018 UNTIL THE HOME WAS SOLD (OCT-2020). AFTER THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS ISSUE WAS DEFINED THE DEFENDANT ASKED THE COURT FOR A CONTINUANCE TO ALLOW HIM TO FILE A CROSS CLAIM WHICH HE HAD IN HIS HAND. THE COURT GRANTED HIS REQUEST FOR A CONTINUANCE. DEFENDANT MUST FILE AND SERVE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $102) SERVED FEB-07-2022, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT AGUILAR, JOSELITO
